text: {"levels":[{"article":2,"instrument":"EURUSD","price":"1.1300","role":"support","quote":"EUR/USD is evidence of that, with the currency pair now slipping below 1.1300 and breaking beneath an important support cluster on the weekly chart."},{"article":2,"instrument":"EURUSD","price":"1.1350","role":"support","quote":"The 1.1350 to 1.1400 region had been doing much of the work in keeping sellers at bay, with the 38.2 Fib retracement level at 1.1355 also doing its part before this."},{"article":2,"instrument":"EURUSD","price":"1.1400","role":"support","quote":"The 1.1350 to 1.1400 region had been doing much of the work in keeping sellers at bay, with the 38.2 Fib retracement level at 1.1355 also doing its part before this."},{"article":2,"instrument":"EURUSD","price":"1.1355","role":"level","quote":"The 1.1350 to 1.1400 region had been doing much of the work in keeping sellers at bay, with the 38.2 Fib retracement level at 1.1355 also doing its part before this."},{"article":2,"instrument":"EURUSD","price":"1.1325","role":"level","quote":"But now, the drop below that area also threatens a firmer break below the June low of 1.1325."},{"article":2,"instrument":"EURUSD","price":"1.1358","role":"level","quote":"And perhaps more importantly, the 100-week moving average (red line) at around 1.1358 also appears to be giving way."},{"article":2,"instrument":"EURUSD","price":"1.1200","role":"support","quote":"From here, 1.1200 is the next obvious downside level to watch."},{"article":2,"instrument":"EURUSD","price":"1.1094","role":"level","quote":"Below that, the 200-week moving average (blue line) around 1.1094 and the psychological mark at 1.1000 will be the next two key levels in view."},{"article":2,"instrument":"EURUSD","price":"1.1000","role":"level","quote":"Below that, the 200-week moving average (blue line) around 1.1094 and the psychological mark at 1.1000 will be the next two key levels in view."}]}
